_readme: Hand-written source of truth for the fhevm NETWORK GROUPS. A group is one gateway deployment with
the host chains it serves: the protocol registry publishes one file per group, and one relayer
serves each group. The relayer is infrastructure, not an on-chain address, so the registry cannot
know it — it is decided here, once. `fhevm-npm sync-fhevm-chains` reads this file to render
fhevm-chains.config.json; adding a group here (with its registry file) adds it to the next sync.
